subject: [PATCH 0/5] mm/gup: batch contiguous pages in follow_page_mask()

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed surprise and concern that the patch series was un-RFC'd without further discussion, specifically questioning why no link to the RFC or change log was provided.

2026-08-03.patch_summary: This patch series optimizes the follow_page_mask() function by batching contiguous pages, reducing page table walks and lock acquisitions. The changes are implemented in five patches, with the first four being code motion or functional equivalent to the original code. Patch 5 introduces a new function, follow_pte_batch(), which allows for batched PTE-mapped mTHP without restarting the walk and re-taking the PTE lock per subpage.
